content.short: Meridian is the first fully on-chain generative art collection on TON, featuring unique digital art and DAO voting.
content.description: Meridian is a pioneering digital art project on the TON blockchain, recognized as the network's first fully on-chain generative art collection. Each piece in the collection is uniquely generated and stored directly on the blockchain, ensuring its permanent and immutable existence. Beyond its artistic value, holding a Meridian NFT grants membership into the 'Meridian Club,' where owners can participate in DAO-style governance and influence the project's future treasury. Meridian is a cultural milestone for the TON NFT community, blending fine art with decentralized coordination.
content.meta: Explore the first on-chain generative art on TON with Meridian. Join the Meridian Club on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
